name: wasm4pm-monorepo
description: High-performance process mining monorepo with WASM acceleration

scripts.test:coverage: pnpm -r --if-present run test:coverage && cd wasm4pm && pnpm run test:coverage
scripts.interview:wasm:node: wasm-pack build crates/wasm4pm-cognition --target nodejs --out-dir ../../packages/cognition/pkg --out-name wasm4pm_cognition --release --features wasm
scripts.interview:wasm:web: wasm-pack build crates/wasm4pm-cognition --target web --out-dir ../../packages/cognition/pkg-web --out-name wasm4pm_cognition --release --features wasm
scripts.interview:wasm: pnpm run interview:wasm:node && pnpm run interview:wasm:web
scripts.interview:bootstrap: pnpm run interview:wasm && pnpm install && pnpm --filter @wasm4pm/cognition build
scripts.release:full: npm run release:forbidden && npm run release:algorithm-reachability && npm run release:algorithm-behavior && npm run release:verify-algorithm-behavior && npm run examples:gate && npm run prepublish:pack-smoke && npm run release:certificate && tsx scripts/release/verify-certificate-authenticity.ts
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/contracts && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/config && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/observability && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/ml && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/planner && npm run build:all --workspace @wasm4pm/core && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/testing && npm run build --workspace wasm4pm && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/engine && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/agents && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/cognition && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/supabase && npm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/cli && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:engine && npm run build:cli
scripts.ci:test: npm run tps:check && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.generate:algorithms: unrdf sync --config unrdf.toml --rule algorithm-registry && pnpm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/templates
scripts.generate:prediction-tasks: unrdf sync --config unrdf.toml --rule prediction-tasks && pnpm run build --workspace @wasm4pm/templates
scripts.docs:check: pnpm run docs:lint && pnpm run docs:link-check
scripts.semconv:check: weaver registry check --registry semconv/registry || echo 'weaver not found - install: cargo install weaver-forge'
